title: Per-bar regime scoring skips an occasional 5m bar when the tick gap spans its close (data-path gap; observe-only shadow rows)
roadmap_unmapped_reason: data-path hygiene for shadow regime heads; no milestone owns per-bar scoring cadence
note:
Filed 2026-11-27 by ML-PRIMARY on Manager 26a's instruction (after #29455).
- MEASURED from /api/diag/log_file shadow_predictions grep=per_bar (5000-line tail, 2026-11-27 02:50-11:40Z, ~8.8 h), distinct scored bar closes vs expected per head:
  - mes-regime-5m-baseline-v1 and mes-regime-5m-lgbm-v2: 104/107 (3 missed, 2.8%)
  - sol-regime-5m-lgbm-v1: 106/107 (1, 0.9%)
  - btc/eth 5m heads: 107/107
  - every 15m head 36/36; every 1h head 9/9
- Rough per day: ~8 MES 5m bars and ~3 SOL 5m bars of 288. Present before AND after #29455 (10:55Z pre-restart, 11:30Z post).
- Cause hypothesis (untested): emit scores only the LAST closed bar per call, so when two 5m closes fall inside one call gap (tick ~85-95 s plus the fetch gate at bar - 30 s, plus slower IBKR fetches for MES) the earlier bar is never scored.
- Fix direction: score every closed bar since the head's last-scored bar (bounded backfill, per-bar dedup unchanged).
- Queue: after the signal_build profile (#29477). Gates this adds or changes: none.
